annotations.text: Onboarding, once. One freeform box replaces the usual twelve-field form: the model extracts age, height, weight, activity and goal, then writes the plan in plain language. Every number stays negotiable by typing a sentence.

Daily loop. Today opens on the one number that matters (kcal left) with macros beneath. The input pill is always at the bottom: type or speak what you ate, confirm the parsed items, correct by talking back.

System: Instrument Serif for headlines and editorial lines, Instrument Sans for UI and numbers. One accent, Sky #177BA8 (dark step #005783, tints #E4F3FC and #C2E4F8). All spacing on an 8 px grid; 24 px gutters, 56 px controls, 24/28 px radii.
